items.title: What Is Attribution?
items.excerpt: Explainer on attribution metadata, which may become one of the most useful bridges between human creativity and AI music: tracing which human works and contributors an AI output draws on.

items.title: 1위 A2O는 AI로 소통·뒤쫓는 2위는 AI곡…K팝에 인공지능 물결
items.excerpt: 올가을 음원 차트 1위를 휩쓴 이수만표 걸그룹 A2O 라이트는 AI 기반 팬 소통 앱을 쓰고, 2위는 AI로 만든 곡이 차지하는 등 K팝 전반에 인공지능 제작·소통 도구가 확산되고 있다.

items.title: 생성 AI가 바꾼 콘텐츠 제작 공정 조명… ICNX 2026, 3일 송도서 개막
items.excerpt: ICNX 2026이 3일 송도컨벤시아에서 개막한다. 테크놀로지 쇼케이스 영상은 텍스트가 영상 장면이 되고 디지털 휴먼이 연기하며 AI 더빙이 입 모양까지 맞추는 제작 공정을 보여준다.

items.title: Suno Plows Ahead With MLC Subpoena, Sets Response Deadline
items.excerpt: Suno is charging ahead with its Mechanical Licensing Collective subpoena in the UMG/Sony training case; a court set a response deadline and the MLC is expected to formally oppose in early November.

items.title: Spotify aiming to get AI remix product live in early 2027, even though it remains unclear if artists and fans are all that interested in it
items.excerpt: Spotify reportedly hopes to launch its AI remix and cover tool early next year as a paid add-on, though it is not clear music creators or fans are excited about it.

items.title: Spotify is hoping to launch its AI remix tool in early 2027
items.excerpt: Spotify, which announced in May an AI tool letting fans create covers and remixes, is now reported to be targeting early 2027 for launch, with a $4-5 monthly add-on price under consideration.

items.title: UMG talks AI music: 'The volume is growing faster than the safeguards'
items.excerpt: On UMG's Q3 earnings call Lucian Grainge sounded the alarm on AI music, citing Deezer figures of more than 90,000 fully AI-generated tracks uploaded to streaming services every day.

items.title: Spotify Reportedly Set to Debut AI Cover & Remix Tool in Early '27
items.excerpt: Spotify is reportedly preparing to launch its long-awaited AI cover and remix tool in early 2027, charging subscribers up to $5 a month extra.

items.title: Zeds Dead on two decades of sampling: “The interest is in the history; AI has no history”
items.excerpt: Zeds Dead discuss two decades of sampling-based production and why they see AI-generated material as lacking the history that makes sampling meaningful.

items.title: Introducing SFX v3 in ElevenCreative and ElevenAPI
items.excerpt: ElevenLabs' SFX v3 brings more reliable multi-sound prompts, cleaner audio and more convincing music and vocals, opening up effects that pair a musical phrase or vocal performance with everyday sounds.

items.title: SkillBox has launched an AI-powered 'event creation' engine
items.excerpt: Indian live entertainment company SkillBox launched Zenith Studio, an AI engine that generates event listings, descriptions, ticketing information and artwork from a single-line prompt.

items.title: MiDiff: MIDI-Conditioned Diffusion Models for Drum Audio Enhancement
items.excerpt: MiDiff is a diffusion-based generative model that restores severely degraded drum recordings by conditioning the reverse process on temporally aligned MIDI piano rolls.

items.title: A Tutorial on Generative Models for Music Audio
items.excerpt: A monograph explaining the methods behind music-audio generation systems - instrumental clips, full songs with vocals, edits and real-time accompaniment - covering neural codecs, token models and diffusion.

items.title: Multimodal Concert Video Editing: System Design and Exploratory Evaluation
items.excerpt: A modular framework that automatically edits multi-camera concert footage by combining instrument activity from multitrack audio, visible instruments, image sharpness and beat-based cut timing.
